Strong tag converts to bold

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p><strong>bold</strong></p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
